hero.title: Wuud.
hero.lede: Novel wooden cladding for contemporary architecture. Real wood — birch, alder, aspen, pine — modified to hold deep relief, then finished natural, translucent or painted. Developed in Finland; brought to Denmark by Beyond Rational.

points.title: Embossed, not printed
points.body: A novel wood-modifying process presses pattern into the surface of real timber — true depth that catches light and throws shadow. Standard patterns. Or fully custom.

points.title: Inside and out
points.body: The same modification weatherproofs the wood and adds fire retardancy — one panel language, from interior walls to building façades.

points.title: From Finnish research
points.body: Developed out of a Business Finland & Aalto University research programme. Conscious, contemporary cladding — now available through Beyond Rational in Denmark.

gallery_head.body: Five interior renders and two pattern samples — the relief at room scale and up close.

cta.lede: Panels, patterns, pricing — tell us the brief and we'll send finishes, formats and a quote.
